name: session_start
title: Record Issue branch
description: Record the start of work on a branch created with the link-branch operation: the base (.pecot-base), the work directory and the session name. Also reports a merged PR of the current branch whose local cleanup is left

base.description: Base branch the branch was created from (base in the link-branch result)

sha.description: Commit the branch was created from (sha in the link-branch result)

stacked_on.description: Prerequisite Issue the branch stacks on (owner/repo/N, stacked_on in the branch_check result; omitted when not stacked)

title.description: Title of the work Issue, for the session name

reads.description: Results of the official GitHub MCP reads

pull_requests.description: Result of list_pull_requests with head <owner>:<current branch> and state all, to find a merged PR whose local cleanup is left

base.description: Base branch the branch starts from

stackedOn.description: Issue number whose branch this one is stacked on (omitted when not stacked)

workDirectory.description: Absolute path of the work directory (omitted when it could not be created)

leftovers.description: Earlier merged PRs whose local cleanup is left undone (omitted when there is none)

pullRequest.description: Merged PR of the current branch whose local cleanup with session_finish is left (owner/repo/N)

detail.description: Full failure text: the error message and the guidance lines that follow it (failure only)

log.description: Raw output of a child process (failure only; omitted when not captured)

warnings.description: Warning messages; continuation lines of a message are indented by two spaces (omitted when there is none)
